    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.Nume)                  AS [Numar OP],

    CAST(s.Suma AS DECIMAL(18,2))                        AS [Suma],

    s.Cont                                               AS [IBAN Beneficiar],

    SUBSTRING(s.Cont,5,4)                                AS [Banca Beneficiar],

    s.Nume                                               AS [Nume Beneficiar],

    s.CNP                                                AS [Cod fiscal beneficiar],

    s.TipPlata                                           AS [Detalii 1],

    'RON'                                                AS [Valuta (RON)],

    NULL                                                 AS [Plata buget],

    '[GetOrSession:Branch]'                              AS [Nume platitor],

    bc.IBANPlatitor                                      AS [IBAN Platitor],

    bc.CodFiscalPlatitor                                 AS [Cod fiscal platitor]

INNER JOIN app.BancaCard bc
    ON bc.CodBanca= @CodBanca

WHERE --s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  s.Anul         = @Anul
  AND s.Luna         = @Luna
  AND s.TipPlata     = @TipPlata
  AND s.DataPlatii = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)

    s.Nume;

SELECT

    NULL                                                 AS [Oras platitor],

    s.Nume                                               AS [Nume Beneficiar],

    NULL                                                 AS [Cod fiscal],

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.Nume)                  AS [Numar OP],

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
;WITH DateALTE AS
(
    SELECT
        s.Marca,
        s.Nume,
        s.CNP,
        s.Suma,
        s.TipPlata,

        UPPER
        (
            REPLACE
            (
                LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.Cont, N''))),
                N' ',
                N''
            )
        ) AS ContNormalizat,

        SUBSTRING
        (
            UPPER
            (
                REPLACE
                (
                    LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.Cont, N''))),
                    N' ',
                    N''
                )
            ),
            5,
            4
        ) AS CodBancaBeneficiar

    FROM app.SumaALTE s

    WHERE s.Anul = @Anul
      AND s.Luna = @Luna
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.TipPlata))
          = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TipPlata))
      AND CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE)
          = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
    (
        ORDER BY
            CodBancaBeneficiar,
            Nume,
            Marca
    ) AS [Numar OP],

    CAST(Suma AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Suma],

    ContNormalizat AS [IBAN Beneficiar],

    CodBancaBeneficiar AS [Banca Beneficiar],

    Nume AS [Nume Beneficiar],

    CNP AS [Cod fiscal beneficiar],

    TipPlata AS [Detalii 1],

    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS [Detalii 2],

    N'RON' AS [Valuta (RON)],

    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS [Plata buget],

    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS [Nume platitor],

    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS [IBAN Platitor],

    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS [Banca platitor],

    CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(1)) AS [Cod fiscal platitor]

FROM DateALTE

ORDER BY
    CodBancaBeneficiar,
    Nume,
    Marca;
